name: Korran
summary: At the Crossroads, Korran watches the Barrens for threats to the Horde. The Darkspear troll serves Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar and studies the silithid emerging across the scrublands.

sections.title: A Scout at the Crossroads
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Korran watches for threats beyond the quilboar and centaur clans. Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar stationed the troll scout there to observe changes in the land. Korran coordinates the gathering of intelligence for the Horde's leadership.

sections.title: The Silithid Incursion
sections.body: Korran now focuses on the Field of Giants in the southern Barrens. Strange, aggressive insectoid creatures called silithid have begun burrowing into the earth. To learn where the swarm came from and what danger it poses to the young Horde, Korran asks passing adventurers to dig up intact eggs with his claw tool.

faq.answer: Korran is a Darkspear troll who watches and studies the Barrens from the Crossroads. He reports to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is Korran investigating in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Korran is investigating the strange, aggressive insectoid creatures called silithid at the Field of Giants in the southern Barrens. Similar swarms have also been reported farther south in Thousand Needles.
Korran serves Belgrom Rockmaul, a seasoned warrior in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Belgrom monitors emerging threats across Kalimdor for the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Korran need silithid eggs?
faq.answer: Korran needs intact silithid eggs to study the swarm's life cycle and origins. He hopes to learn what the creatures are and how great a threat they pose to Horde territory.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, Korran watches Kalimdor's changing ecology for new threats like the silithid while Orgrimmar secures its borders.
As a Darkspear troll, you bring scouting and survival instincts to the arid Barrens, where Korran studies strange, alien beasts with practical cunning.
